name: Newton International Fellowship
amount: Up to GBP 280,000 total (salary and on-costs, research expenses, relocation and visa costs, indirect costs)
other_rules: must be based outside the UK when applying
PhD held or thesis defended by the closing date
no more than 5 years of active full-time postdoctoral experience (career breaks excluded)
natural sciences (humanities and social sciences go to the British Academy)
UK sponsor required (one application per sponsor per round)
notes: 2026 round opened 15 Jan and closed 11 Mar 2026; next round expected on a similar schedule. One nominated reference. Eligible for Global Talent visa fast-track. Applied via Flexi-Grant.
